summary: [Shopify] events: Webhooks are the primary event surface: orders/create, orders/updated, products/update, inventory_levels/update, customers/create, refunds/create, fulfillments/create... Register only what you need. Respond 2xx within 5 seconds or Shopify retries with exponential backoff up to 48 hours, then disables the subscription. Every handler idempotent: retries/duplicates are normal operation. Bulk operations API for large backfills (async -> poll -> JSONL).
